notes: Encoded ONLY from Purefire's own page. The page covers Peerless, Pinnacle, Purefire and Pavillion jointly; this file is the Purefire entry only and does not reuse any other brand's file (no usesStylesOf: sister listing alone never establishes shared-system reuse). HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 3 (6-digit serials, page states age must be obtained by contacting Peerless, units pre-1984) — no serial rule exists on the page. ANSI/CSA standards-date estimation mentioned on other pages is never encoded as a serial rule. Style 1 list/detail PREFIX DISCREPANCY: list shows 339030-200012, detail shows 339090-200012; the date suffix (last six digits) is identical in both, so both page-stated forms are examples and both decode 2000-12.

styles.era: 12-digit serials (6 + 6 with dash), year + month in last six digits
styles.notes: Page states the last six digits represent the year and month. Only the year-first parse validates against the page example: suffix 200012 -> year 2000 (4 digits, positions [6,10]) + month 12 (positions [10,12]); the month-first parse would give month 20, invalid. Hence year [6,10], month [10,12] on the normalized 12-digit serial.

styles.era: 10-digit serials (6 + 4 with dash), month + year in last four digits
styles.notes: Page states the last four digits represent the month and year, in that order: suffix 1284 -> month 12 (positions [6,8]) + year 84 -> 1984 (positions [8,10]).
